name: SEO and Publication Readiness

requiredChecks.label: Meta title and description
requiredChecks.riskIfMissing: Weak search preview and inconsistent public presentation

requiredChecks.label: Schema.org structured data
requiredChecks.riskIfMissing: Lower machine readability for organization and article pages

requiredChecks.label: Open Graph and social preview metadata
requiredChecks.riskIfMissing: Poor previews when links are shared

requiredChecks.label: Canonical URL policy
requiredChecks.riskIfMissing: Duplicate URL signals and unclear primary page

requiredChecks.label: hreflang language structure
requiredChecks.riskIfMissing: Wrong language or regional result may be shown

requiredChecks.label: Sitemap readiness
requiredChecks.riskIfMissing: Incomplete discovery of approved public pages

requiredChecks.label: Image alt text and metadata
requiredChecks.riskIfMissing: Accessibility and media preview quality loss

requiredChecks.label: Internal link recommendations
requiredChecks.riskIfMissing: Disconnected public narrative and weaker navigation

requiredChecks.label: Review-only noindex guard
requiredChecks.riskIfMissing: Unapproved pages may become publicly indexable

guardrails: No public publication without explicit approval
No mass distribution from publishing workflow
No DNS or Cloudflare production route changes
No merge or production deploy before approval token
